about: Long-task pack (BRIEF OPENCODE X4): 17 tasks whose material does not fit in 8k tokens, judged on disk. 8 kinds of long task, each in an easy and a hard version, plus one 'ask' task where the right move is to ask instead of guessing. 'generator' builds the big seed files (long_seed.build); 'long' holds the judge settings (long_judge.verdict). {SECRET} is replaced by a fresh fake key each load. Run this pack with --profile core4_product (Paolo, 2026-11-03): the exam rules' digit-loop veto refuses l_long_rules' cumulative out.txt writes.
